description: Who logged into the dashboard and when, router activity, and account changes across every location.
ownerOnlyBody: Staff Activity shows who signed in and what they changed across the whole organization. Only the organization owner can see this page.
emptyLogins: No dashboard sign-ins yet — sign-ins for this organization will appear here.
emptyRouter: No router events yet — router activity across your locations will appear here.
emptyActivity: No account changes yet — role assignments and account or settings changes across your organization will appear here.
